This is a remote position.
About the Role

Were seeking a Full stack Engineer (leaning backend) with solid experience in AI Ops, AI/ML model integration, and a strong understanding of LLM architectures. As a key member of our IT Innovation Experimentation Team, youll help us develop and deploy cutting-edge solutions that leverage AI to address important challenges. Youll work closely with a talented team of product managers, engineers, and automation specialists, participating in rapid experiments and prototypes to drive our projects forward.

What You ll Do

Design, build, and maintain robust backend services (ideally in Nest.js/TypeScript, but were open to discussing your preferred tech stack) that power our AI-driven applications.

Integrate, optimize, and deploy AI/ML models and prompts, with a focus on LLMs and AI Ops best practices.

Collaborate with our skilled frontend engineers (React/TypeScript/Blazor/C#) to create user-friendly and impactful experiences.

Take ownership of projects from concept to launch proactively identifying opportunities, developing effective solutions, and driving them to completion.

Stay current with the latest advancements in AI/ML, sharing your knowledge and insights with the team.

Contribute to a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and constructive feedback.

Communicate clearly and effectively with teammates, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment.

Work closely with technical product managers and other engineers to deliver rapid experiments and prototypes, addressing key questions and accelerating our progress.

Share your expertise and enthusiasm with others, contributing to a positive and growth-oriented team dynamic.

Maintain a professional and responsive presence in our fully remote setting.

What We re Looking For

Proven experience building and scaling backend systems (Nest.js/TypeScript/ Python/Jupyter experience is a plus).

Solid understanding of AI Ops and MLOps principles, with practical experience deploying and managing AI/ML models.

Hands-on experience with LLM architectures (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face, custom models).

Fullstack skills comfortable working across the stack, even if your primary focus is backend.

A proactive and solutions-oriented mindset; youre not afraid to take initiative and tackle challenges.

Strong communication and collaboration skills; you enjoy working as part of a team.

A commitment to continuous learning and professional development in the field of AI/ML.

Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative spirit. We value team members who are positive, respectful, and contribute to a supportive work environment.

A genuine interest in our mission and a desire to use your skills to make a difference.

Must Have Skills:

Full stack Engineer (leaning backend)

Proven experience building and scaling backend systems (Nest.js/TypeScript/ Python/Jupyter experience is a plus).

Solid understanding of AI Ops and MLOps principles, with practical experience deploying and managing AI/ML models.

Hands-on experience with LLM architectures (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face, custom models).

Fullstack skills comfortable working across the stack, even if your primary focus is backend.

A proactive and solutions-oriented mindset; youre not afraid to take initiative and tackle challenges.

Strong communication and collaboration skills; you enjoy working as part of a team.

A commitment to continuous learning and professional development in the field of AI/ML.

Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative spirit. We value team members who are positive, respectful, and contribute to a supportive work environment.

Key Accountabilities Activities

Assist in developing AI agents using both proprietary (e.g., OpenAI GPT) and open-source LLMs
(e.g., Qwen, Llama).

Implement ASR pipelines to support real-time speech-to-text use cases in meetings.

Contribute to model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and deployment for user-facing features.

Support the creation of QA and evaluation pipelines to monitor model accuracy and output quality.

Collaborate with product and engineering teams to align AI features with the overall product roadmap.

Conduct research on emerging ML/LLM techniques and experiment with integration into product use cases.

Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure reliable AI functionality.

Solid foundation in ML/DL principles and practical coding.

Comfortable working in a startup environment adaptive, fast-moving, and proactive.

Description

Were looking for a AI Engineer to join our team and help design, build and ship the agentic, retrieval and voice systems at the core of what we deliver for clients.

Responsibilities

Youll work end-to-end across our six-stage delivery process - from AI mapping and architecture through development, deployment and continuous evolution. Day to day, youll:

Build AI agents and workflow automation systems that carry real business processes from start to finish.
Design document intelligence solutions that combine OCR with LLMs to extract, understand and act on unstructured documents.
Develop multi-step AI workflows and decision engines that chain models, tools and business logic reliably.
Build RAG and retrieval pipelines over vector stores like Qdrant, pgvector, MongoDB Atlas and Redis, tuned for accuracy, latency and cost.Develop real-time voice agents using tools such as LiveKit, ElevenLabs, Deepgram and Whisper.
Integrate foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and open models (Llama, Mistral) into client systems and deploy them on cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) with Kubernetes and Terraform.
Ship all of the above with the evaluation, guardrails and observability needed to run reliably at scale - then keep improving it.
Qualifications
3+ years of software engineering experience, with hands-on work taking AI/ML or LLM-powered features to production.
Strong Python skills and fluency across the modern GenAI stack.
Depth in at least one of our focus areas - agentic systems, RAG/retrieval, or voice - and the drive to grow across the rest.
Strong evaluation skills: you build eval harnesses, measure model and system quality against real metrics, and iterate rather than eyeballing outputs.
A guardrails-first instinct - you design for safety, failure modes, hallucination, cost and reliability before a system ever reaches users.
Comfort integrating models via APIs and deploying containerized workloads on the cloud.
Clear communication and the ability to work directly with clients as an embedded team member.
Job Benefits
Fully remote across India - work from wherever youre most productive, with no commute and no relocation. Weve been remote-first for years, so the tools and habits that make distributed work smooth are already in place.
Flexible timings - we care about outcomes, not hours logged. Structure your day around when you do your best work and the commitments in your life outside it, and coordinate with your team on the overlap that matters.
Long weekend leaves - regular long weekends built into the calendar give you real time to step away, recharge and come back sharp, on top of your standard leave.
Opportunity to work with senior engineers, applied-AI researchers and data scientists on real production systems, and to grow quickly through direct mentorship and genuinely hard problems.

Model/version management and prompt versioning
CI/CD pipelines for GenAI applications

Drive continuous enhancement of user experience through experimentation and feedback loops.

Experience building end-to-end GenAI/Agentic AI products, including backend services and frontend web apps.
Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, n8n, Co-pilot for building modular, agent-based systems.
Practical experience designing multi-agent architectures and orchestrating reasoning and action workflows.
Strong experience with Vector Databases and Graph Databases (Azure AI Search, Neo4j, Databricks Vector DB) for hybrid, semantic and relationship-driven search.
